PR (cited in the notes as #21894): fix(cli): ignored resources should not be pruned during restore [closed]
Using the flag `--skip-resources-with-label` will cause the backup to prune live resources, which may result in an outage.

Ignored resources in backup should not be pruned from live
Live resource with ignore label should not be pruned if they are missing from backup.

Caused by https://github.com/argoproj/argo-cd/pull/21694
